timeline.text: Imagine a video where the voiceover keeps going, but the picture just... stops moving.
That was happening to nearly half of every voiced clip on the site.
And most of the hundred and fifty features didn't even have a clip yet -- just two did.
Now Remotion builds a short clip for each feature, and loops the footage instead of freezing it to match the voice.
The clip catalog went from two demo clips to over one hundred fifty.
